$comment: Which published package exports each operation as a typed constant.
A separate file rather than a header comment inside the .graphql documents:
an operation's id is sha256 of the LITERAL file contents, so adding a line
to a document changes its id and forces a coordinated backend manifest
resync for a purely editorial change.
This governs the EXPORTED CONSTANTS only. persisted-operations/manifest.json
and the published packages/sdk/persisted-manifest.json both keep every
operation regardless of audience — the manifest is the API's allowlist, and
an operation missing from it is unexecutable by anyone.
sdk  — a customer's storefront calls it
cli  — the deploy CLI calls it; a frontend never should
Every operation must appear here; the generator fails on a missing or stale
entry rather than guessing an audience.
